comment: Conversion routes between official stable PCSX2 save-state formats. A route is advertised only with the evidence listed. 'direct' routes are performed by the native converter (pcsx2-stateconvert), compiled from the same source as the experimental PCSX2 2.8.2 loader. Releases that share a format (stable-formats.json, releases) have identical save-state code by comparison of their tags; each route was run with the releases it names.

routes.evidence: States written by official 2.4.0 (21 states, 20 games) convert completely and load in the unmodified official PCSX2 2.8.2 Windows release (asset digest verified) without errors; input-driven gameplay observed, with behavior matching the unconverted states in official 2.4.0; states saved by 2.8.2 afterwards reload in the same unmodified build.

States written by official 2.6.3 (4 games) convert and load in the unmodified official 2.8.2 release; Monster Jam, SpongeBob Battle for Bikini Bottom and Pac-Man World 2 resumed and responded or animated; Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3, saved by 2.6.3 on a black loading screen, stayed black.

Internal Structures stream unchanged (validated by the full parser and carried over); SPU2 keeps the same mixer model without the deferred loop-start fields. In the unmodified official 2.6.3 release (asset digest verified), 23/23 converted state/disc pairs (states written by official 2.4.0, 20 games) loaded without errors; with Start posted, pause menus toggled or play resumed in 12 games and other states waited on in-game dialogs, matching the same states' behavior in 2.8.2.

Genuine states written by official 2.0.3 (Monster Jam: Urban Assault, Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3, Pac-Man World 2, SpongeBob Battle for Bikini Bottom) convert completely and load in the unmodified official 2.8.2 release without errors (GS state upgraded from version 8 to 9). With the same Start input each resumed the same way as the unconverted state in official 2.0.3: Monster Jam's attract run, then title screen and profile menu; Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3 level intro into live play with the run timer counting; the SpongeBob cutscene; Pac-Man World 2 waiting on its memory-card dialog. The experimental 2.8.2 loader also resumed a 2.0.3 state directly and saved a native state that the unmodified 2.8.2 release then resumed (pause menu toggled, play continued). 2.0.0-2.0.2 write the identical serialization (source comparison).

unsupported.reason: Reverse conversion would have to rewind the SPU2 decode-ahead FIFO, whose reads may already have crossed loop points and raised IRQs; the earlier format cannot represent that state exactly.
Not implemented: a pending KeyOff mask (0x9A55) has no equivalent in 0x9A54, where key-off takes effect when written.
